name: Oyabe (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Oyabe city emblem in green: a stylised tower-like device within a ring open at the bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Oyabe, a city in Toyama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 1963.

features.role: Oyabe city emblem — a stylised tower-like device within a ring open at the bottom
